properties: At most three nonfallback weights remain positive, plus fallback; sum and nonnegativity are preserved in exact arithmetic.
The fourth order statistic, positive-part operation and mass transfer are continuous even across ties. This only proves continuity relative to continuous input weights.
The existing upstream authored skin top-4 selection is discontinuous; this local policy does not repair that separate boundary.
To avoid a new discontinuity at fallback weight zero, apply the rule even when fallback is initially zero. Conditionally enabling it only when a fifth positive weight appears is not continuous.
Always applying it changes some already-admitted four-bone rows with no removed constraint mass. The most symmetric four-way row becomes entirely fallback.

It changes motion: transferred mass follows the fallback rather than its original bones. Per-pose displacement is the sum of removed weights times fallback-versus-original transformed point differences. Quality/action gates must remain unchanged.
